title_as_printed: Experimental density differences Dp between H2O and {xCO2+(1-x)H2O} at different temperatures, pressures, and mole fractions x, together with calculated densities p, molar volumes Vm, apparent molar volumes Vphi of CO2, and excess molar volumes VmE: m0 = 1 mol/kg; p0 = 1 g/cm3; Vm0 = 1 cm3/mol

footnotes_as_printed.a: The values of 'm' reported in the previous table 1 (ref 1) were values of 'm' = m.(1-x)M(H2O)/{(1-x)M(H2O) + xM(CO2)} where M denotes molar mass, and not the molalities m reported here.

pressure_note: p/MPa given per row (28, 33, 38 MPa sets with small deviations); the paper does not define it further (vibrating-tube densimeter, single-phase fluid)

value.what: solution density printed by the authors (rho0 = 1 g/cm3) = density of pure water + Dp, calculated from the measured density difference; used as the datum so that the near-critical IAPWS cross-check does not hold rows

value2.what: measured density difference {xCO2+(1-x)H2O} minus pure H2O at the same T and p; p0 = 1 g/cm3

value3.what: apparent molar volume of CO2, calculated by the authors

composition.other_species: pure water, no salt; x is the CO2 mole fraction in {xCO2+(1-x)H2O}

volume_basis_evidence: density differences; no per-volume concentration unit
extra_unmapped: Vm/Vm0 (molar volume of the solution, calculated)
notes: Replicate rows (two or three runs at the same T, p, x) are kept as printed. Blocks are 28/33/38 MPa sets across T = 651-726 K (above the critical temperature of water). Standard conditions not applicable. Minus signs written as '-'.
